<!-- pr-reviewer: cfa62b88fb84f05dd866eb08775e6657c9045f48 -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

I read the full diff and checked it against upstream/main's current AGENTS.md.
There is no earlier review. There are no blocking findings.

The tests cover both required cases from #3925. The catalog case has four plunge columns with three depths each. Each depth adds at most one stepdown. The carried-stock case uses `EditOperationParams` and checks four cached warnings, their move references, depths, limits, and advisory status.

## Local results

Reviewed head: `cfa62b88fb84f05dd866eb08775e6657c9045f48`.
Base: `81365c33bb65e426ee0869eb763a29bd5a91abdb`.
Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-3927`.

`git merge --no-edit upstream/main` reported `Already up to date.` The base is the PR head's direct parent. No trial merge commit was needed. HEAD is the reviewed PR head; HEAD^1 is the base.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. The `plunge_depth_tab` suite built and ran: 2 passed, 0 failed.
- `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTC_WRAPPER=sccache cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'`: all five test steps passed. All 11 light tests passed. Each step built its target in release mode. The separate build of all test targets was omitted.
- `git diff upstream/main --check`: passed.

## Extra suites run

- `app suites: example_catalog`: 41 passed, 4 ignored, 0 failed.
- `app suites: example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `app suites: example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed, 0 failed.

The diff changes no fixtures or import code. The extra importer suites do not apply.

## Safety and goldens

This PR changes tests and a decision record. It changes no production code, posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, or stock simulation. The safety-tier requirement to repeat two mutations does not apply. I did not repeat the author's mutations or change code.

No goldens moved. No `.nc`, `.cl`, or `examples/catalog/**` file changed. The three catalog suites passed. There is no UI change that needs screenshots. No heavy lane was required for this test-only diff.

The existing carried-stock behavior remains covered by #3926. This PR records it and preserves the warning coverage.

## Requested before merge

None.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge sweep: this PR cannot merge this sweep. The only `<!-- pr-reviewer: -->` marker on the PR is by the PR author (mkinney), which does not count. A clean pr-reviewer marker, written by a collaborator who did not write the change, at this head (`cfa62b88fb84f05dd866eb08775e6657c9045f48`), is needed before it can merge.
